name: Mirror
rule: Turns light 60 degrees. Light from behind, or hitting it head-on, goes straight on.

name: Splitter
rule: Two beams at 60 degrees either side, each half the Intensity (rounded up).

name: Filter
rule: Keeps only its stone's colours and adds Focus. Light it shares nothing with ends here.

name: Prism
rule: Splits light into its colours: red left, green straight, blue right.

name: Lens
rule: Gathers every beam, then fires them as one beam where it points.

name: Resonator
rule: Adds Focus to light sharing its colour; more for an exact match.

name: Echo
rule: Repeats the last gem this light struck, at Rough strength.

name: Tinter
rule: Adds its stone's colours to the light.

name: Geode
rule: Swallows the light and scores it at half value.
